name: 8940-steadychat-8blora-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct -- the ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, same weights, and the `base_model_name_or_path` the served adapter itself declares. The Llama 3.1 Community License applies.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. One GPU, one server, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, bf16, ~16.1 GB of weights: 32 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, 32 query over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, RoPE scaled to 131072 positions. ONE LoRA adapter on top: `algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora`, r=64, lora_alpha=16, dropout 0.1, `target_modules: [q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj]`.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=8 req/s, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 2400 requests with a 1800 s safety cap; ~1800 requests are measured. The 1800 s cap is a runaway guard, not a bound the run should reach.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, seed 42: prompts centred on 290 tokens (stdev 200, clamped 32-1024), generations on 170 (stdev 150, clamped 16-512), `ignore_eos` so each request generates its full sampled length. The radix cache is off, so nothing is reused between requests and every prompt is a real prefill.
purpose: A fact-generation assistant on an 8-billion-parameter model with a LoRA adapter, serving eight short single-turn requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped by the reader, so the engine would start
# without the key and the run would silently not be the one declared here.

model-path: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tp-size: 1
lora-paths: ["lora=algoprog/fact-generation-llama-3.1-8b-instruct-lora"]
lora-backend: triton
max-loras-per-batch: 8

# NOT a tuning choice: at this commit the server asserts on start that an adapter is only served
# with the radix cache off, and refuses to start otherwise.
disable-radix-cache: true
